card.name: Inside the word intrathecal
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the middle or end pieces of the word intrathecal (athe, cal) in warnings about spinal-fluid administration. It also fires weakly on a few other split words like extravasation.

modes.label: Intrathecal spelled out
modes.description: Pieces of intrathecal such as 'cal' or 'athe' when the word is split up.
modes.example: PRIALT is intended for intrathe<<cal>> delivery using the Medtronic Synch

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Other long words split partway, such as extravasation, or a word like botanical or altitude.
